| Danger          | Where or in what situations does the hazard arise?                                                                                                                                                    | Preventative action                                                                                                                        |
|-----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| A risk of burns | From hot surfaces such as Racks Containers, baking sheets, shelf grills etc. Inside the entire cavity, including all parts that are or were inside during cooking On the inside of the appliance door | Before starting cleaning tasks, wait until the cavity has cooled to below 50°C / 122°F or use the 'cool down' function to cool the cavity. |
| A risk of burns | From hot surfaces such as Racks Containers, baking sheets, shelf grills etc. Inside the entire cavity, including all parts that are or were inside during cooking On the inside of the appliance door | Wear specified protective clothing, in particular protective gloves.                                                                       |
